lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; i4562 p. 5, Line 12: "The limitations on lines 5 and 11 apply to the taxpayer, and not to each separate business or activity. Therefore, if you have more than one business or activity, you may allocate your allowable section 179 expense deduction among them." The candidate is true on every return with more than one Schedule C, so Schedule C refuses there even with no section 179 deduction to allocate (classm.f8995.3: two Schedules C, lines 8, 10 and 12 $0.00, Form 1040 line 37 computed; project false, candidate true). The project refuses only when line 12 differs from the 2025 elections (line 8) and there is more than one Schedule C; otherwise each business deducts its own elections, an allocation the "may allocate" sentence permits, so the project computes correctly where the candidate refuses and the candidate names no condition the project misses. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/s179.json; 1,099 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 28 partial records): 1,533 of 1,627 comparisons agree; differences: 53 project-refuses, 38 value, 3 project-unknown; by full-interview outcome of the return: completed: 10 value; incomplete: 2 project-unknown; refused: 53 project-refuses, 28 value, 1 project-unknown; witnesses (project / candidate): value e.g. classm.f8995.3 (false / true; return completed), classm.asset.1 (false / true; return refused); project-refuses e.g. classm.carloan.1 (refusal at person[taxpayer].sc[biz_a].scveh[car_1].low_use / true; return refused), classm.scveh.5 (refusal at person[taxpayer].sc[biz_a].ho_both_limits / true; return refused); project-unknown e.g. classm.sc.4 without s179.line10 (unknown s179.line10 / true; return incomplete), classm.se.2 without s179.line10 (unknown s179.line10 / true; return incomplete). The project-refuses records are cited upstream gates (scveh.low_use, sc.ho_both_limits, sc.ho_multi, sc.ho_screened, household.roster_bad) on refused returns; the project-unknown records withhold s179.line10 on returns the full interview refuses or leaves incomplete.

Ruling: ambiguity; i4562 p. 4, Line 1: "Generally, the maximum section 179 expense deduction is $2,500,000 for section 179 property (including qualified section 179 real property) placed in service during the tax year beginning in 2025."; "Tip: You can use Worksheet 1 to assist you in determining the amount to enter on line 1."; Worksheet 1: "3. Enter the smaller of line 1 or line 2 here ... 4. Enter the amount from line 3 here and on Form 4562, line 1". amb.2025.s179_carryover_no_property records the Worksheet 1 cost cap as the alternative reading; the owner adopted line 1 as the $2,500,000 the line 1 instruction states (TASKS T-043, research memo ambiguities/research/amb.2025.s179_carryover_no_property.md: with that line 1, lines 5 to 12 compute 26 U.S.C. 179(b)(3)(B) exactly, while the cap changes no return without a carryover and withholds a carryover on a return with no 2025 property, e.g. stage14.s179.carryover_no_property). Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/s179.json; 1,099 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 28 partial records): 8 of 1,627 comparisons agree; differences: 1584 value, 18 candidate-refuses, 17 candidate-unknown; by full-interview outcome of the return: completed: 528 value; incomplete: 277 value, 11 candidate-unknown; refused: 779 value, 18 candidate-refuses, 6 candidate-unknown; witnesses (project / candidate): value e.g. classm.f2441.1.deepseek ($2,500,000.00 / $0.00; return completed), classm.f2441.2.deepseek ($2,500,000.00 / $0.00; return completed); candidate-refuses e.g. classm.carloan.1 ($2,500,000.00 / refusal at person[taxpayer].sc[biz_a].scveh[car_1].low_use; return refused), stage14.veh.refuse_low_use ($2,500,000.00 / refusal at person[taxpayer].sc[rides].scveh[car].low_use; return refused); candidate-unknown e.g. classm.f8889.3.deepseek ($2,500,000.00 / unknown $sc@person[sample]; return incomplete), classm.f8889.3 ($2,500,000.00 / unknown $sc@person[sample]; return incomplete). The value differences are returns whose line 2 is under $2,500,000 (project $2,500,000.00; candidate the cost, $0.00 with no section 179 property). The candidate-refuses and candidate-unknown records arise because the candidate's line 1 reads line 2: cited refusals (scveh.low_use, scveh.screened, asset.screened, asset.listed_low) and the Schedule C roster on returns the full interview refuses or leaves incomplete, which the project's own line 2 reads too. Project stands under the owner's ruling.

Ruling: representation; project retained. i4562 p. 5, Line 11, Individuals, and p946 p. 19, "Interest from working capital of your trade or business". Both take the smaller of line 5 and the business income (Schedule C income before section 179, Form 1040 line 1a and the working-capital interest), not less than zero. The project asks s179.wc_interest only where it can matter (s179.wc_interest_if_limited: a section 179 deduction is figured, the business income before it is less than line 5, and line 2b is above zero) and uses zero otherwise; the second reads the answer on every return. Where the business income is at least line 5, line 11 is line 5 on both; where line 2b is zero the interest is zero on both; where no deduction is figured (lines 9 and 10 zero) line 12 is zero on both, as ruled when BUG-0474 was fixed (BUG-0482). Re-reviewed because this round reworded s179.line10 (a carryover with no 2024 Form 4562, BUG-0542); no expression changed. Project stands.
